title: pg-rescue runs
description: pg-rescue run-log rates per chain, from the run log (runs.jsonl) shipped to Loki as service_name="pg-rescue" (darwin/modules/pg-rescue). Definitions match the README "Measuring from the run log" recipes. Every query matches the raw JSON line with RE2 line filters and a regexp stage, not `| json`, because LogQL cannot iterate the attempts array and the log source is shipped raw (body = the run-log line). A run started with --handlers has no chain and appears as a series with an empty chain label. Agent cost and failing handlers read attempt positions 1 to 8; an attempt at a later position is not counted. Run history starts at the first activation that shipped the source (the receiver reads new lines only).

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Wrapped runs in the selected range, per chain, including the happy path. This is the denominator of the three rates beside it.

panels.title: Common-case rate
panels.description: Share of runs that ended `success`, or `resolved` by an attempt tagged `deterministic`. The line filter keys on the attempt object field order tags, outcome, as the run-log writer encodes it.

targets.expr: (sum by (pr_chain) (count_over_time({service_name="pg-rescue"} |~ `"result":"success"|"result":"resolved".*"tags":\[[^\]]*"deterministic"[^\]]*\],"outcome":"resolved"` | regexp `"chain":"(?P<pr_chain>[^"]*)"` | pr_chain =~ "$chain" [$__range])) or on(pr_chain) (sum by (pr_chain) (count_over_time({service_name="pg-rescue"} | regexp `"chain":"(?P<pr_chain>[^"]*)"` | pr_chain =~ "$chain" [$__range])) * 0)) / sum by (pr_chain) (count_over_time({service_name="pg-rescue"} | regexp `"chain":"(?P<pr_chain>[^"]*)"` | pr_chain =~ "$chain" [$__range]))

panels.title: Agent rate
panels.description: Share of runs `resolved` by an attempt tagged `agent`.

targets.expr: (sum by (pr_chain) (count_over_time({service_name="pg-rescue"} |~ `"result":"resolved".*"tags":\[[^\]]*"agent"[^\]]*\],"outcome":"resolved"` | regexp `"chain":"(?P<pr_chain>[^"]*)"` | pr_chain =~ "$chain" [$__range])) or on(pr_chain) (sum by (pr_chain) (count_over_time({service_name="pg-rescue"} | regexp `"chain":"(?P<pr_chain>[^"]*)"` | pr_chain =~ "$chain" [$__range])) * 0)) / sum by (pr_chain) (count_over_time({service_name="pg-rescue"} | regexp `"chain":"(?P<pr_chain>[^"]*)"` | pr_chain =~ "$chain" [$__range]))

panels.title: Escape rate
panels.description: Share of runs that ended `deferred` or `unhandled`, i.e. escaped the chain.

targets.expr: (sum by (pr_chain) (count_over_time({service_name="pg-rescue"} |~ `"result":"(deferred|unhandled)"` | regexp `"chain":"(?P<pr_chain>[^"]*)"` | pr_chain =~ "$chain" [$__range])) or on(pr_chain) (sum by (pr_chain) (count_over_time({service_name="pg-rescue"} | regexp `"chain":"(?P<pr_chain>[^"]*)"` | pr_chain =~ "$chain" [$__range])) * 0)) / sum by (pr_chain) (count_over_time({service_name="pg-rescue"} | regexp `"chain":"(?P<pr_chain>[^"]*)"` | pr_chain =~ "$chain" [$__range]))

panels.title: Runs by chain and result
panels.description: Run count per interval by chain and result (success, resolved, deferred, unhandled, error, interrupted).

targets.expr: sum by (pr_chain, pr_result) (count_over_time({service_name="pg-rescue"} | regexp `"chain":"(?P<pr_chain>[^"]*)"` | regexp `"result":"(?P<pr_result>[a-z]+)"` | pr_chain =~ "$chain" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Agent cost per interval

`"position":1,"tags":\[[^\]]*"agent"[^\]]*\],[^{}]*"meta":\{[^{}]*"total_cost_usd":(?P<pr_cost>[0-9.eE+-]+)` | pr_cost != "" | label_format pr_slot=`1` | unwrap pr_cost [$__interval])) or sum by
